spans.s: An assemblage of young women; अवधृत्य दिवो$पि यौवतैर्नसहाधीतवतीमिमामहम्
;11.9; मनुष्यनारीजनतो$पि यौवतं दिवौकसां श्रेष्ठतमं वदन्ति Rām.
The quality of a young woman (beauty &c.); the state of being a young woman; अहो विबुधयौवतं वहसि तन्वि पृथ्वीगता
यौवतेयः [yauvatēyḥ], The son of a young woman.
यौवन [yauvana], a. (-नी f.) [यूनो भावः अण्] Young, juvenile.
नम् Youth; (fig. also), youthfulness, prime or bloom of youth, puberty; मुग्धत्वस्य च यौवनस्य च सखे मध्ये मधुश्रीः स्थिता
A number of young persons, especially women.-Comp. -अन्त a. ending in youth, being a prolonged youth; यौवनान्तं वयो यस्मिन् नान्तकः कुसुमायुधात्
.-अवस्था, -दशा youthfulness, puberty. -आरम्भः prime of youth, budding youth;
. -आरूढ a. one who has arrived at adolescence or puberty.
N. of Cupid. -कण्टकः, -कम्, -पिडका an erruption or pimples on the face indicative of youth.
indiscretion natural to youth. -दशा the period of youth. -प्रान्तः the verge of youth.
the female breast. -श्री the beauty of youthfulness. -स्थ a.
यौवनाश्वः [yauvanāśvḥ], N. of Māndhātṛi, son of Yuvanāśva.
यौवराज्यम् [yauvarājyam], The rank or rights of an heir-apparent; यौवराज्ये$भिषिक्तः 'crowned heir-apparent'; निश्चित्य सचिवैः सार्धं यौवराज्यममन्यत
